flows:
Navigate to https://ecommerce-playground.lambdatest.io then Type 'canon camera' into the search box at the top of the page.
Click the Search button.
Get what the page shows after that and save as {{what_happened}}.
Verify that the search results list at least one product with 'Canon' in its name.

analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, "The search results list contains at least one product w
assert: The search results list contains at least one product with 'Canon' in its name.

summary:
The test expected a Canon product for a search phrase that currently has no matching product in the catalog. The results page plainly says that no product matches the search criteria.
Use a search phrase known to match a seeded Canon catalog item, or seed a matching Canon product before running this verification.
one_liner: The search completed normally, but the catalog returned no products for “canon camera,” so the expected Canon result was not available.
